_readme: Sample slots for src/audio.js. Every slot is optional: an empty list keeps the synthesized sound.
Paths are relative to this file. Any format the browser can decode works (ogg, mp3, wav, m4a).
List 2-3 variants per slot where 'want' says so; playback picks one at random with a +-4% pitch jitter.
Only add files you have the rights to ship (your own recordings or CC0 packs).

wood.note: fairway wood; falls back to driver

wedge.note: wedge strike; falls back to iron

sand.note: bunker splash shot; falls back to wedge

land-green.note: landing on a green; falls back to land

land-sand.note: landing in sand; falls back to land

land-path.note: ball on a cart path; falls back to land
